WITH units AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.sentreg,
    sf.instownpct,
    tr.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL 
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(instownpct) as mix_baseline
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM units
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT 
    u.sentreg,
    u.instownpct,
    u.ordertypedist,
    mb.mix_baseline,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM units u
  JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oa
  WHERE u.instownpct > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_kept,
  AVG(instownpct / mix_baseline) as avg_ratio_to_baseline,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) as avg_excess_over_overall
FROM kept_units
